data.title: Oil Near $100 Emerges as Consensus for Next Year With Iran War
data.description: Oil market participants are increasingly pricing crude to be capped near $100 a barrel over the next year, as demand is forced to slow down to counter millions of barrels of supply losses caused by the US-Iran war.
